name: WEDCO
old_description: This year, we proudly celebrate 75 years of delivering trusted solutions! Since 1950, WEDCO has been built on strong relationships and dedicated leadership. We’re especially grateful to the Elmore Family, whose vision and commitment guided us for decades. In 2008, we began transitioning ownership from the Elmores, and today, we’re proudly 100% employee-owned.
about:
WEDCO is headquartered in Reno, Nevada, with additional locations in Fallon, Carson City, and Winnemucca. The company was founded in 1950 and operated for decades under the leadership of the Elmore family. In 2008, ownership began transitioning from the Elmores, and today WEDCO is 100 percent employee-owned.

The company functions as an electrical distributor and solutions partner, maintaining over $10 million in inventory across its four Northern Nevada branches. It supplies products from brands such as Square D, Schneider Electric, Milwaukee Tool, Southwire, and Eaton, covering panelboards, load centers, push buttons, drives, soft starters, surge protection, and safety switches. In addition to product distribution, WEDCO provides VFD programming and start-up services, motor control training, project management, switchgear and lighting quotations, and general technical training.

WEDCO serves industrial pump contractors, residential and commercial electrical contractors, industrial automation and MRO customers, mining operations, and utility companies throughout Northern Nevada. Its customer base includes contractors and end users who rely on local stock and technical support for electrical infrastructure projects.

The company emphasizes its employee-ownership model and long-standing community ties — including support for the University of Nevada, youth sports, and the Boys & Girls Club — as factors that align its incentives with customer outcomes and regional economic health.
